changeSet.author: MoonPark
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS moonpark_master_data.parking_zone ( zone_code character varying(10) COLLATE pg_catalog."default" NOT NULL, zone_name character varying(100) COLLATE pg_catalog."default" NOT NULL, description character varying(500) COLLATE pg_catalog."default", active boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true, created_by character varying(150) COLLATE pg_catalog."default" NOT NULL DEFAULT 'system', created_date timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), modified_by character varying(150) COLLATE pg_catalog."default", modified_date timestamp with time zone, CONSTRAINT parking_zone_pkey PRIMARY KEY (zone_code), CONSTRAINT parking_zone_code_check CHECK (zone_code ~ '^[A-Z][A-Z0-9]{0,9}$') );

changeSet.author: MoonPark
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS moonpark_master_data.permission ( permission_id bigint NOT NULL GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY ( INCREMENT 1 START 1 MINVALUE 1 MAXVALUE 9223372036854775807 CACHE 1 ), permission_name character varying(50) COLLATE pg_catalog."default" NOT NULL, description character varying(200) COLLATE pg_catalog."default", created_by character varying(150) COLLATE pg_catalog."default" NOT NULL DEFAULT 'system', created_date timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), modified_by character varying(150) COLLATE pg_catalog."default", modified_date timestamp with time zone, CONSTRAINT permission_pkey PRIMARY KEY (permission_id), CONSTRAINT permission_name_key UNIQUE (permission_name) );

changeSet.author: MoonPark
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS moonpark_master_data.role ( role_id bigint NOT NULL GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY ( INCREMENT 1 START 1 MINVALUE 1 MAXVALUE 9223372036854775807 CACHE 1 ), role_name character varying(30) COLLATE pg_catalog."default" NOT NULL, description character varying(200) COLLATE pg_catalog."default", created_by character varying(150) COLLATE pg_catalog."default" NOT NULL DEFAULT 'system', created_date timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), modified_by character varying(150) COLLATE pg_catalog."default", modified_date timestamp with time zone, CONSTRAINT role_pkey PRIMARY KEY (role_id), CONSTRAINT role_name_key UNIQUE (role_name) );

changeSet.author: MoonPark
changeSet.sql:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS moonpark_master_data.role_permission ( role_id bigint NOT NULL, permission_id bigint NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT role_permission_pkey PRIMARY KEY (role_id, permission_id), CONSTRAINT role_permission_role_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (role_id) REFERENCES moonpark_master_data.role (role_id) MATCH SIMPLE ON UPDATE NO ACTION ON DELETE CASCADE, CONSTRAINT role_permission_permission_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (permission_id) REFERENCES moonpark_master_data.permission (permission_id) MATCH SIMPLE ON UPDATE NO ACTION ON DELETE CASCADE );
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS role_permission_permission_id_idx ON moonpark_master_data.role_permission (permission_id);
